claim: Survey 'Findings' lines come from counts, not verified classifications, and seeded fingerprints from one recording should not be trusted across games.
limit: No cross-game fingerprint match observed; matcher proven only on a synthetic relocated routine.

evidence.text: Across 28 seeded entries: 7 back buffer, 15 several routines draw directly, 4 one routine, 1 cell copier, 1 unclassified; fingerprints from the first 3,000 frames of one recording.
